avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces prednisolone bioavailability and efficacy; may precipitate adrenal insufficiency with dose reduction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, monitor clinical response closely and adjust prednisolone dose accordingly

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root (high dose >3g/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid effects compound prednisolone's sodium retention and potassium depletion; increases hypertension and hypokalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or limit to <1g/day; monitor electrolytes and blood pressure if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune function, potentially counteracting prednisolone's immunosuppressive effects
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; inform patient of potential reduced corticosteroid efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation; potential CYP3A4 interaction may slightly increase prednisolone metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; coordinate use with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Prednisolone impairs calcium absorption and increases bone loss; supplementation helps mitigate osteoporosis risk
caution_supplements.action: Encourage adequate intake (1000-1200 mg calcium, 800-2000 IU vitamin D daily) to offset corticosteroid-induced bone loss

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Prednisolone increases sodium retention and fluid accumulation; excessive sodium exacerbates hypertension, edema, and heart failure risk
avoid_foods.action: Restrict sodium intake to <2g/day; counsel on avoiding processed, canned, and fast foods

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase prednisolone levels and adverse effects
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; consider alternative citrus if frequent intake

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, potatoes with skin)
caution_foods.mechanism: Prednisolone increases urinary potassium loss; adequate dietary potassium helps prevent hypokalemia
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate intake; monitor serum potassium levels, especially with prolonged use

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase gastric irritation and anxiety; prednisolone already increases GI upset risk
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderation; take prednisolone with food to minimize GI effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood glucose, blood pressure, electrolytes (especially potassium), and bone density during chronic prednisolone therapy. Patient education on sodium restriction, adequate calcium/vitamin D intake, and infection precautions due to immunosuppression is essential.
